# Toon shading

Cel shading on any lit material: the light snaps into flat bands (or follows a ramp you draw) while each surface keeps its color, the highlight becomes one flat spot, and an optional hard rim outlines the silhouette.

<EffectDemo effect="toon" />

## Usage

```ts
import { patchMaterial } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { toon } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/toon';

const effect = toon({ preset: 'anime' });
patchMaterial(mesh.material, effect);
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => renderer.render(scene, camera));
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.mode = 'bands'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter           | Type                    | Default                                                                                                      | Range      | Description                                                                             |
| ------------------- | ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mode`              | 'bands' \| 'ramp'       | `'bands'`                                                                                                    |            | Even bands of light, or a brightness ramp you draw.                                     |
| `bands`             | integer                 | `3`                                                                                                          | 2 – 8      | Number of light bands.                                                                  |
| `hardness`          | number                  | `1`                                                                                                          | 0 – 1      | How sharply the bands step; lower values soften them.                                   |
| `ramp`              | [position, hex color][] | `[[0, '#262626'], [0.45, '#262626'], [0.5, '#9a9a9a'], [0.85, '#9a9a9a'], [0.9, '#ffffff'], [1, '#ffffff']]` |            | Ramp mode: brightness from dark (left) to lit (right); its gray levels set the shading. |
| `specular`          | number                  | `1`                                                                                                          | 0 – 1      | Strength of the flat highlight.                                                         |
| `specularThreshold` | number                  | `0.85`                                                                                                       | 0.3 – 1    | Brightness above which the highlight appears.                                           |
| `specularColor`     | hex color               | `'#ffffff'`                                                                                                  |            | Color of the highlight.                                                                 |
| `rim`               | number                  | `0`                                                                                                          | 0 – 1      | Strength of the hard rim.                                                               |
| `rimWidth`          | number                  | `0.3`                                                                                                        | 0.01 – 0.9 | Width of the rim.                                                                       |
| `rimColor`          | hex color               | `'#ffffff'`                                                                                                  |            | Rim color.                                                                              |
| `amount`            | number                  | `1`                                                                                                          | 0 – 1      | Mix between the original shading and the toon shading.                                  |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset  | Settings                                                      |
| ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `anime` | `bands: 2`, `rim: 0.8`, `rimWidth: 0.2`                       |
| `soft`  | `bands: 4`, `hardness: 0.6`, `specular: 0.5`                  |
| `comic` | `bands: 3`, `rim: 1`, `rimWidth: 0.35`, `rimColor: '#101018'` |
| `flat`  | `bands: 2`, `specular: 0`                                     |
| `ramp`  | `mode: 'ramp'`                                                |

Apply one with `toon({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Materials · tracked as story X12.5 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Kind:** material effect. `patchMaterial(material, effect)` splices it into MeshBasic, Lambert, Phong, Standard, Physical, Toon and Matcap materials, so lighting, fog and shadows keep working; `unpatchMaterial` removes it. See [material effects](/guide/materials).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 6.2 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/toon`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Cel shading by banding lit brightness, after Decaudin, Cartoon-looking rendering of 3D scenes, 1996.

## Related

- [Toon posterize](./posterize) — Flattens brightness into a few bands while keeping each color’s hue, and darkens edges, for a cartoon look on any image.
- [Edge detect (Sobel, Canny)](./edges) — Finds edges in the image itself (not the 3D geometry, unlike outline): Sobel gradients of brightness, optionally thinned to one-pixel lines as Canny does, over the image, on paper, or glowing on black.
- [Fresnel glow](./fresnel-glow) — Adds light where a surface turns away from the camera, the rim lighting of force fields, energy shields and selected objects.
